creator: nocturne
statement: Chizoar is in Frostbite Tundra Crystal Base Camp; first requirement is Bellows quest to kill 50 Neyeptunes.

creator: nocturne
statement: Second quest is to kill a single Neyeptune and gain at least 3200 experience.

creator: nocturne
statement: Raise class XP with talents like Just EXP to meet the experience requirement; fairly easy at this point.

creator: nocturne
statement: Third quest is killing a Giant Neyeptune; needs the Tachion of the Titans worship bonus from World 3 to spawn giants.

creator: nocturne
statement: Tachion of the Titans worship bonus allows giant mobs to spawn after killing some mobs.

creator: nocturne
statement: Easiest way to get a giant mob to spawn is to wait for your weekly reset for a spawn chance.

creator: nocturne
statement: Need at least 1250 Accuracy for 5% hit chance and 3750 Accuracy for 100% hit chance against the boss.

creator: nocturne
statement: Boss has 40 million HP so it may take time depending on your damage.

creator: nocturne
statement: It took him about 20 to 25 minutes to bring Chizoar to about 10% HP.

creator: nocturne
statement: Boss spins purple thing spawning three to four Ice Mines in the horns; each attackable limb gets a defensive shield until mines are killed.

creator: nocturne
statement: Mines do no damage when close or run over; just kill them to resume damaging the boss.

creator: nocturne
statement: Leg ability spawns Ice Spikes from ceiling; avoid the tip and they do about 90 damage with 500 defense.

creator: nocturne
statement: Tusks grow larger and swipe a huge area.

creator: nocturne
statement: When killing Ice Mines stand far enough out away because tusks can still hit you even on platforms.

creator: nocturne
statement: Standing on second leg avoids the tusks and melee range attack; the stomp creates a wave doing significant damage.

creator: nocturne
statement: Back leg ability shields him then he stomps and creates a line of spikes across the whole map.

creator: nocturne
statement: He only does the back leg spike ability if you are standing at the back leg.

creator: nocturne
statement: Favorite spot is under the tusks: tusks and melee stomp can't hit you and no Ice Spikes spawn.

creator: nocturne
statement: Abilities hitting farther out hit multiple legs since every leg is damageable.

creator: nocturne
statement: Kill Ice Mines from back to front because they are timed; new mines only spawn after a delay following killing the last.

creator: nocturne
statement: Main drops are food and coins.

creator: nocturne
statement: Chizoar Spikes are the primary boss drop and are needed for crafting and smithing.

creator: nocturne
statement: Chizoar Blankie is a pendant with 5 Weapon Power and 15% Total Damage and +3% Mob Respawn time; chance drop with good stats.
